name: A trusted Sentinel is missing

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic quest-chain scene; in-world date unknown

summary: Melyria sends the inquiry to Thyn’tel Bladeweaver in Darnassus. Velinde had served before Melyria at Forest Song, and her disappearance has left the Sentinels without an answer. Thyn’tel is reluctant to expose her belongings to a stranger; the priestess had earned the trust of her people, who still expect her to return. The quest supplies no calendar date for this absence. The search begins between two records: a vision at the ruined shrine and a city that has kept Velinde’s effects in the hope she might come home.
